query: Do I need to prove I have enough money?

passages.text: You’ll need to show you have enough money to support yourself.
If you have been in the UK with a valid visa for at least 12 months on the date of your application, you do not need to show you have enough money to support yourself.

query: When must a course meet specific requirements?

passages.text: If the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies has been assigned by a probationary sponsor, the course must meet one of the following requirements.

query: What must a student route applicant prove about prior studies?

passages.text: An applicant who has, or previously had, permission on the Student route and is applying for permission to stay as a Student must show academic progress from the previous courses of study.

An applicant who has, or previously had, permission on the Student route and is applying for permission to stay as a Student must show academic progress from the previous courses of study when one of the exceptions in ST 14.4 applies.

query: How long can a work placement be in a course?

passages.text: A work placement must be assessed as an integral part of the course and must not be longer than one third of the total length of the course.
A work placement is allowed to be longer than one third of the total length of the course when there is a statutory requirement that it must be so, or where ST 17.3.

query: How long can a student study below degree level courses?

passages.text: If the course is below degree level, the grant of permission must not lead to the applicant being granted more than two years’ permission as a Student to study courses below degree level from the age of 18.
ST 19.2 allows the applicant to be granted more than two years’ permission as a Student to study courses below degree level from the age of 18.

query: How long can a student be granted permission for degree courses?

passages.text: If the course is at degree level, the grant of permission must not lead to the applicant being granted more than five years’ permission as a Student from the age of 18 to study courses at degree level.

If the course of study is one of those listed at ST 19.4, the grant of permission may lead to the applicant being granted more than five years’ permission as a Student from the age of 18 to study courses at degree level.

query: Can an unmarried partner in the UK apply as fiancé?

passages.text: If you’re in the UK as an unmarried partner, do not apply to extend your visa as a fiancé, fiancée or proposed civil partner.
If you’re in the UK as an unmarried partner and you become engaged, do not apply to extend your visa as a fiancé, fiancée or proposed civil partner.

query: When can a case be placed on hold pending outcome?

passages.text: You may exceptionally place the case on hold pending the outcome.

query: Can someone on immigration bail apply for a Skilled Worker visa?

passages.text: Any applicant who is in the UK on immigration bail does not hold permission to be in the UK and is not suitable for the Skilled Worker route.
Applicants who are in the UK on immigration bail are permitted by the Immigration Rules in respect of periods of overstaying.

query: What is required for a worker to stay?

passages.text: A worker is allowed to switch into the Skilled Worker route as a prison officer.

query: What changed about the skill threshold?

passages.text: On 22 July 2025, the skill threshold increased to Regulated Qualifications Framework (RQF) level 6.

query: How are overstays treated under current rules?

passages.text: The transitional arrangements in (d) apply to people granted permission under the rules in place before 22 July 2025 who have held continuous permission since that point.
Where the Exceptions for Overstayers section of Part Suitability applies, that period of overstaying will be disregarded.

query: When must sponsors inform UKVI of changes?

passages.text: Sponsors must still notify UKVI of any of the above changes.

query: Do I need to check records for the past 12 months?

passages.text: You do not need to check their records for the past 12 months.

query: When must permission end date be 14 days after CoS end date?

passages.text: In both circumstances, the end date of permission must be 14 days after the end date stated on the applicant’s CoS.
For some doctors, the end date of permission must be 14 days after the end date stated on the applicant’s CoS.

query: When can you grant 14 days permission to stay?

passages.text: For applications for permission to stay, you may exceptionally grant 14 days permission to stay to allow the applicant to make a further application or leave the UK without becoming an overstayer.

For applications for permission to stay, if the end date of the CoS has passed, you may exceptionally grant 14 days permission to stay to allow the applicant to make a further application or leave the UK without becoming an overstayer.

query: Can volunteers receive money for their work?

passages.text: They must not be paid or receive other money for the voluntary work.
They may receive reasonable expenses as described in that section.

query: Is an A-rated sponsor required for all Skilled Worker applications?

passages.text: The sponsor must be listed as A-rated on the Home Office’s register of licensed sponsors.
The sponsor need not be listed as A-rated when the applicant was last granted permission as a Skilled Worker and is applying to continue working for the same sponsor as in their last permission.

query: What is required for a UK job sponsorship?

passages.text: The applicant must be sponsored for a job in an eligible SOC 2020 occupation code listed in Appendix Immigration Salary List for the nation of the UK where that job is based.
The applicant must be sponsored for an eligible job within a SOC 2020 occupation code listed in Appendix Immigration Salary List for the nation of the UK where that job is based, where relevant.

query: How long does a child receive permission?

passages.text: A child will be granted permission which ends on the same date as whichever of their parents’ permission ends first.
If both parents have (or are being granted) settlement or British Citizenship, the child will be granted permission for 3 years.

query: Does a group prize count for Global Talent eligibility?

passages.text: If the applicant states they have been awarded a prize listed in Appendix Global Talent: Prestigious Prizes, they will not normally qualify unless the award specifically names the applicant as part of the group or organisation.

If the applicant states they have been awarded a prize listed in Appendix Global Talent: Prestigious Prizes, but that prize was awarded to a group or organisation the migrant is associated with, they will not normally qualify unless the award specifically names the applicant as part of the group or organisation.

query: What permission must an applicant have for the Global Talent route?

passages.text: The applicant must have, or have been granted, permission on the Global Talent route.
The applicant must have, or have been granted, permission on the Global Talent route when that permission was granted under the Tier 1 (Exceptional Talent) route.

query: Are applicants on immigration bail eligible for the Innovator Founder route?

passages.text: Any applicant who is in the UK on immigration bail does not meet the suitability requirements for the Innovator Founder route.
Any applicant who is in the UK on immigration bail and whose period of overstaying is permitted by the Immigration Rules meets the suitability requirements for the Innovator Founder route.

query: What knowledge must applicants have about life in the UK?

passages.text: They must have sufficient knowledge about life in the UK, in accordance with paragraph INNF 20.1 of the Immigration Rules.
They must have sufficient knowledge about life in the UK, in accordance with paragraph INNF 20.1 of the Immigration Rules, if they are aged 65 or over at the date the application is made.

query: What happens to overstayers in immigration law?

passages.text: They must not be in the UK in breach of immigration laws.
Where the Exceptions for Overstayers section of Part Suitability applies, that period of overstaying will be disregarded.

query: What is the UK transit visa for travelers?

passages.text: Transit Visitor: for those who want to transit the UK on route to another country outside the Common Travel Area and who will enter the UK for up to 48 hours by crossing the UK border.

passages.text: the child may be refused entry to the UK

query: What entry clearance can a visa national obtain?

passages.text: A visa national must hold entry clearance as a Standard Visitor, Marriage/Civil Partnership Visitor or Transit Visitor.
If a visa national meets the requirements for admission under Appendix Visitor: Transit Without Visa Scheme, they may apply for permission to enter on arrival in the UK.

passages.text: The applicant must provide evidence that there will be adequate accommodation, without recourse to public funds, for the family.

passages.text: The applicant must be in the UK with valid leave to remain as a partner under this Appendix.

The applicant must provide evidence that they will be able to adequately maintain and accommodate themselves and any dependants in the UK without recourse to public funds, unless paragraph EX.1.

passages.text: The applicant must provide evidence that there will be adequate accommodation in the UK, without recourse to public funds, for the family.
The family includes other family members who are not included in the application but who live in the same household, which the family own or occupy exclusively, unless paragraph EX.1.

passages.text: The applicant must be in the UK with valid leave to remain as a parent under this Appendix.
